audit_status.source_base: Hebrew 1 Kings / Melakhim Aleph chapter 8, first-pass draft aligned to public-domain verse structure; formal liturgical and witness audit remains required.
audit_status.review_note: Reviewed for ark procession, mass animal sacrifice, cloud and glory, temple containment tension, covenant and dynasty, judicial oaths, defeat and land return, drought, famine and illness theology, foreigner prayer, war prayer, captivity, forgiveness, animal slaughter, and national feast.

verses.restored: Then Solomon assembled elders of Israel, all heads of tribes, and leaders of ancestral houses of children of Israel to King Solomon in Jerusalem, to bring ark of covenant of YHWH up from City of David, which is Zion.

familiar.text: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto king Solomon in Jerusalem, that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which is Zion.

verses.restored: All men of Israel assembled to King Solomon at feast in month Ethanim, seventh month.

familiar.text: And all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto king Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.

verses.restored: All elders of Israel came, and priests carried ark.

familiar.text: And all the elders of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark.

verses.restored: They brought up ark of YHWH, tent of meeting, and all holy vessels in tent; priests and Levites brought them up.

familiar.text: And they brought up the ark of the LORD, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, even those did the priests and the Levites bring up.

verses.restored: King Solomon and all congregation of Israel assembled to him were before ark, sacrificing sheep and cattle that could not be counted for multitude.

familiar.text: And king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel, that were assembled unto him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen, that could not be told nor numbered for multitude.

verses.restored: Priests brought ark of covenant of YHWH to its place, inner sanctuary of house, most holy place, beneath wings of cherubim.

familiar.text: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto his place, into the oracle of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims.

verses.restored: Cherubim spread both wings over place of ark and covered ark and its poles from above.

familiar.text: For the cherubims spread forth their two wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.

verses.restored: Poles were extended so their ends were seen from holy place before inner sanctuary but not seen outside; they are there until this day.

familiar.text: And they drew out the staves, that the ends of the staves were seen out in the holy place before the oracle, and they were not seen without: and there they are unto this day.

verses.restored: Nothing was in ark except two stone tablets Moses placed there at Horeb, where YHWH cut covenant with children of Israel when they came from land of Egypt.

familiar.text: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables of stone, which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.

verses.restored: When priests came out from holy place, cloud filled house of YHWH.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the house of the LORD,

verses.restored: Priests could not stand to minister because of cloud, for glory of YHWH filled house of YHWH.

familiar.text: So that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of the LORD.

verses.restored: Then Solomon said, YHWH said YHWH would dwell in thick darkness.

familiar.text: Then spake Solomon, The LORD said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

verses.restored: Building, I have built a house of dwelling for you, an established place for you to dwell forever.

familiar.text: I have surely built thee an house to dwell in, a settled place for thee to abide in for ever.

verses.restored: The king turned his face and blessed all congregation of Israel, while all congregation stood.

familiar.text: And the king turned his face about, and blessed all the congregation of Israel: (and all the congregation of Israel stood;)

verses.restored: He said, Blessed be YHWH, Divine of Israel, who spoke with mouth to David my father and fulfilled with hand, saying:

familiar.text: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which spake with his mouth unto David my father, and hath with his hand fulfilled it, saying,

verses.restored: From day I brought my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city from all tribes of Israel to build house for my name there; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.

familiar.text: Since the day that I brought forth my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build an house, that my name might be therein; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.

verses.restored: It was in heart of David my father to build house for name of YHWH, Divine of Israel.

familiar.text: And it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

verses.restored: YHWH said to David my father, Because it was in your heart to build house for my name, you did well that it was in your heart.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto David my father, Whereas it was in thine heart to build an house unto my name, thou didst well that it was in thine heart.

verses.restored: Nevertheless you shall not build house; your son coming from your body shall build house for my name.

familiar.text: Nevertheless thou shalt not build the house; but thy son that shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house unto my name.

verses.restored: YHWH established word spoken. I arose in place of David my father, sat upon throne of Israel as YHWH spoke, and built house for name of YHWH, Divine of Israel.

familiar.text: And the LORD hath performed his word that he spake, and I am risen up in the room of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

verses.restored: There I set a place for ark containing covenant of YHWH, which YHWH cut with our ancestors when bringing them out from land of Egypt.

familiar.text: And I have set there a place for the ark, wherein is the covenant of the LORD, which he made with our fathers, when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.

verses.restored: Solomon stood before altar of YHWH in presence of all congregation of Israel and spread his hands toward heavens.

familiar.text: And Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven:

verses.restored: He said, YHWH, Divine of Israel, there is no Divine like you in heavens above or earth beneath, keeping covenant and covenant-kindness with servants walking before you with all heart.

familiar.text: And he said, LORD God of Israel, there is no God like thee, in heaven above, or on earth beneath, who keepest covenant and mercy with thy servants that walk before thee with all their heart:

verses.restored: You kept for your servant David my father what you spoke; you spoke with mouth and fulfilled with hand this day.

familiar.text: Who hast kept with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him: thou spakest also with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thine hand, as it is this day.

verses.restored: Now YHWH, Divine of Israel, keep for your servant David my father what you spoke: A man shall not be cut off for you before me from sitting upon throne of Israel, if your children guard their way to walk before me as you walked.

familiar.text: Therefore now, LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel; so that thy children take heed to their way, that they walk before me as thou hast walked before me.

verses.restored: Now, Divine of Israel, please let your word be confirmed, which you spoke to your servant David my father.

familiar.text: And now, O God of Israel, let thy word, I pray thee, be verified, which thou spakest unto thy servant David my father.

verses.restored: But will Divine truly dwell upon earth? Look, heavens and heavens of heavens cannot contain you—how much less this house I built.

familiar.text: But will God indeed dwell on the earth? behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house that I have builded?

verses.restored: Yet turn toward prayer of your servant and his plea, YHWH my Divine, to hear cry and prayer your servant prays before you this day.

familiar.text: Yet have thou respect unto the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer, which thy servant prayeth before thee to day:

verses.restored: Let your eyes be open toward this house night and day, toward place of which you said, My name shall be there, to hear prayer your servant prays toward this place.

familiar.text: That thine eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place of which thou hast said, My name shall be there: that thou mayest hearken unto the prayer which thy servant shall make toward this place.

verses.restored: Hear plea of your servant and your people Israel when they pray toward this place; hear in heavens, your dwelling place; hear and forgive.

familiar.text: And hearken thou to the supplication of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, when they shall pray toward this place: and hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place: and when thou hearest, forgive.

verses.restored: If a person sins against neighbor and an oath is placed upon him to make him swear, and oath comes before your altar in this house,

familiar.text: If any man trespass against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house:

verses.restored: hear in heavens, act, and judge your servants: condemn guilty by bringing his way upon his head, and justify righteous by giving according to righteousness.

familiar.text: Then hear thou in heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way upon his head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.

verses.restored: When your people Israel are struck before enemy because they sinned against you, and they return, confess your name, pray, and plead to you in this house,

familiar.text: When thy people Israel be smitten down before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee, and shall turn again to thee, and confess thy name, and pray, and make supplication unto thee in this house:

verses.restored: hear in heavens, forgive sin of your people Israel, and return them to land you gave their ancestors.

familiar.text: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest unto their fathers.

verses.restored: When heavens are shut and there is no rain because they sinned against you, if they pray toward this place, confess your name, and turn from sin when you afflict them,

familiar.text: When heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou afflictest them:

verses.restored: hear in heavens, forgive sin of your servants and your people Israel, teach them good way they should walk, and give rain upon your land which you gave your people as inheritance.

familiar.text: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, that thou teach them the good way wherein they should walk, and give rain upon thy land, which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance.

verses.restored: If there is famine in land, pestilence, blight, mildew, locust, devouring insect, or enemy besieges them in land of their gates—any plague, any sickness—

familiar.text: If there be in the land famine, if there be pestilence, blasting, mildew, locust, or if there be caterpiller; if their enemy besiege them in the land of their cities; whatsoever plague, whatsoever sickness there be;

verses.restored: every prayer, every plea made by any human or all your people Israel, each knowing plague of own heart and spreading hands toward this house,

familiar.text: What prayer and supplication soever be made by any man, or by all thy people Israel, which shall know every man the plague of his own heart, and spread forth his hands toward this house:

verses.restored: hear in heavens your dwelling place, forgive, act, and give to each according to ways, whose heart you know—for you alone know heart of all children of humanity—

familiar.text: Then hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and do, and give to every man according to his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou, even thou only, knowest the hearts of all the children of men;)

verses.restored: so they may revere you all days they live upon land you gave our ancestors.

familiar.text: That they may fear thee all the days that they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.

verses.restored: Also concerning foreigner who is not of your people Israel but comes from distant land for your name's sake—

familiar.text: Moreover concerning a stranger, that is not of thy people Israel, but cometh out of a far country for thy name’s sake;

verses.restored: for they shall hear of your great name, strong hand, and outstretched arm—when the foreigner comes and prays toward this house,

familiar.text: (For they shall hear of thy great name, and of thy strong hand, and of thy stretched out arm;) when he shall come and pray toward this house;

verses.restored: hear in heavens your dwelling place and do according to all foreigner calls to you for, so all peoples of earth may know your name, revere you as your people Israel, and know this house I built is called by your name.

familiar.text: Hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for: that all people of the earth may know thy name, to fear thee, as do thy people Israel; and that they may know that this house, which I have builded, is called by thy name.

verses.restored: If your people go out to battle against enemy by way you send them and pray to YHWH toward city you chose and house I built for your name,

familiar.text: If thy people go out to battle against their enemy, whithersoever thou shalt send them, and shall pray unto the LORD toward the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house that I have built for thy name:

verses.restored: hear in heavens their prayer and plea and uphold their cause.

familiar.text: Then hear thou in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

verses.restored: If they sin against you—for there is no human who does not sin—and you become angry, give them before enemy, and captors carry them captive to enemy land, far or near,

familiar.text: If they sin against thee, (for there is no man that sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy, far or near;

verses.restored: and return to you with all heart and soul in land of enemies who carried them captive, and pray toward their land you gave ancestors, city you chose, and house I built for your name,

familiar.text: And so return unto thee with all their heart, and with all their soul, in the land of their enemies, which led them away captive, and pray unto thee toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, the city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name:

verses.restored: hear their prayer and plea in heavens your dwelling place and uphold their cause.

familiar.text: Then hear thou their prayer and their supplication in heaven thy dwelling place, and maintain their cause,

verses.restored: Forgive your people who sinned against you and all transgressions they transgressed against you; give them compassion before captors, so captors have compassion upon them.

familiar.text: And forgive thy people that have sinned against thee, and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against thee, and give them compassion before them who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them:

verses.restored: For they are your people and inheritance, whom you brought from Egypt, from midst of iron furnace.

familiar.text: For they be thy people, and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest forth out of Egypt, from the midst of the furnace of iron:

verses.restored: Let your eyes be open to plea of your servant and plea of your people Israel, hearing them in all they call to you.

familiar.text: That thine eyes may be open unto the supplication of thy servant, and unto the supplication of thy people Israel, to hearken unto them in all that they call for unto thee.

verses.restored: For you separated them for yourself as inheritance from all peoples of earth, as you spoke by hand of Moses your servant when you brought our ancestors from Egypt, Lord YHWH.

familiar.text: For thou didst separate them from among all the people of the earth, to be thine inheritance, as thou spakest by the hand of Moses thy servant, when thou broughtest our fathers out of Egypt, O LORD God.

verses.restored: When Solomon finished praying all this prayer and plea to YHWH, he arose from before altar of YHWH, from kneeling upon knees with hands spread to heavens.

familiar.text: And it was so, that when Solomon had made an end of praying all this prayer and supplication unto the LORD, he arose from before the altar of the LORD, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven.

verses.restored: He stood and blessed all congregation of Israel with loud voice, saying:

familiar.text: And he stood, and blessed all the congregation of Israel with a loud voice, saying,

verses.restored: Blessed be YHWH, who gave rest to people Israel according to all spoken. Not one word failed from all good word spoken by hand of Moses servant.

familiar.text: Blessed be the LORD, that hath given rest unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant.

verses.restored: May YHWH our Divine be with us as with our ancestors; may YHWH not leave or abandon us.

familiar.text: The LORD our God be with us, as he was with our fathers: let him not leave us, nor forsake us:

verses.restored: May YHWH incline our hearts toward YHWH, to walk in all ways and keep commands, statutes, and judgments commanded to our ancestors.

familiar.text: That he may incline our hearts unto him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and his statutes, and his judgments, which he commanded our fathers.

verses.restored: May these words with which I pleaded before YHWH be near YHWH our Divine day and night, to uphold cause of servant and cause of people Israel, each day's matter in its day,

familiar.text: And let these my words, wherewith I have made supplication before the LORD, be nigh unto the LORD our God day and night, that he maintain the cause of his servant, and the cause of his people Israel at all times, as the matter shall require:

verses.restored: so all peoples of earth may know YHWH is Divine; there is no other.

familiar.text: That all the people of the earth may know that the LORD is God, and that there is none else.

verses.restored: Let your heart be whole with YHWH our Divine, to walk in statutes and keep commands as this day.

familiar.text: Let your heart therefore be perfect with the LORD our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as at this day.

verses.restored: The king and all Israel with him sacrificed sacrifice before YHWH.

familiar.text: And the king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the LORD.

verses.restored: Solomon sacrificed peace offerings to YHWH: twenty-two thousand cattle and one hundred twenty thousand sheep. Thus king and all children of Israel dedicated house of YHWH.

familiar.text: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered unto the LORD, two and twenty thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the LORD.

verses.restored: That day king consecrated middle of court before house of YHWH, for there he offered burnt offering, grain offering, and fat of peace offerings, because bronze altar before YHWH was too small to contain them.

familiar.text: The same day did the king hallow the middle of the court that was before the house of the LORD: for there he offered burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings: because the brasen altar that was before the LORD was too little to receive the burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings.

verses.restored: At that time Solomon held feast, and all Israel with him, a great assembly from entrance of Hamath to wadi of Egypt, before YHWH our Divine, seven days and seven days—fourteen days.

familiar.text: And at that time Solomon held a feast, and all Israel with him, a great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt, before the LORD our God, seven days and seven days, even fourteen days.

verses.restored: On eighth day he sent people away. They blessed king and went to tents joyful and glad of heart for all goodness YHWH had done for David servant and Israel people.

familiar.text: On the eighth day he sent the people away: and they blessed the king, and went unto their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that the LORD had done for David his servant, and for Israel his people.

translation_notes: Solomon explicitly admits that heavens cannot contain the Divine. The temple bears the name and directs prayer; it does not imprison, monopolize, or geographically exhaust Divine presence.
The ark contains covenant tablets tied to liberation from Egypt. Sacred memory should resist new systems of forced labor and domination.
Cloud and glory interrupt priestly service. Religious professionals do not control Divine manifestation.

The prayer repeatedly interprets defeat, drought, famine, epidemic, illness, and captivity through sin. These ancient theological claims must never be used to blame modern victims, disabled people, sick people, disaster survivors, or occupied populations.
Judicial oath language assumes Divine exposure of guilt but does not replace evidence, due process, protection from false accusation, or appeal.
The foreigner's prayer is welcomed and heard without ethnic conversion being stated. Sacred access extends beyond Israel.
Prayer for battle cannot authorize aggressive war, nationalism, conquest, atrocities, or certainty that one's military cause is Divine.
Captivity prayer centers repentance but also asks captors to show compassion. It must not justify enslavement, deportation, or collective exile.
The dedication sacrifices an enormous number of animals. Festival joy cannot erase animal death, labor, waste, environmental load, or unequal access to abundance.
The congregation blesses the king, but covenant faithfulness remains the standard by which the king is judged.
safety_note: Do not weaponize this prayer to blame sickness, famine, drought, military defeat, displacement, or captivity on victims' sins. Do not use the temple to exclude foreigners or sanctify war. Center forgiveness, compassion, accessible prayer, justice, and the Divine who cannot be contained.
